titleStmt.title: Samaritan Pentateuch, Chester Beatty Library MS 751

publicationStmt.p: CC BY-NC 4.0 (the dataset's README and LICENSE)

The source archive publishes this transcription as Text-Fabric data, not XML. This file is a TEI P5 transcription made from that data, which is the closest scholarly standard for a transcription of a single manuscript.
